Data-Driven. Detail-Oriented. Decisive.

I'm a Data Analyst with 1.5+ years of experience transforming complex, large-scale datasets into clear, actionable business insights. My expertise spans SQL, Excel, Power BI and Python — enabling end-to-end analysis from data cleaning to interactive dashboard delivery.
